name: Season Pass / Battle Pass
tagline: A time-limited reward track with free and premium tiers, where completing in-app actions advances the user along a progression of rewards.
desc: The season pass works when the economy it lands in is ready for it. In Clash of Clans, the Gold Pass launched into an economy Supercell had deliberately deepened first. The pass should accelerate player goals, not satisfy them entirely. Spend once, engage daily.
principle: Spend once, engage daily. The pass converts a one-time payment into a recurring daily reason to open the app.
warn: Reward distribution across the season is the design decision: front-loading leaves the later track with less to pull against. AB test before full activation.
lifecycle: Mid-to-late lifecycle. Requires an established economy to land without cannibalising other revenue.
